rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SEAL Frameworks provides structured access to the Security Alliance's open-source security standards and frameworks for Web3 builders. It enables AI assistants to search, retrieve, and compare security framework content through a local stdio server. The server is read-only and supports Claude CLI, OpenCode, and Cursor configurations.
